To unlock Superior Shinobi, complete three narrative steps. They do not need to be completed in order.

Step One: Discipline of Body and Mind

Spend 4 Down-Time and attempt either Athletics, Acrobatics, or Chakra Control, followed by either Ninshou, Illusions, or Intimidation. Beat DC 18 using only your base Ability Score modifier and ranks of Mastery. Gain one stack of Superior on a success; three stacks complete this step. Each additional 2 Down-Time spent grants +2 to the roll.

Step Two: Complete Success/Failure

Either achieve complete victory over a Solo Adversary without falling below 50% maximum HP, or personally deal damage equal to half its maximum HP; alternatively suffer a critical, shattering defeat such as losing civilians under your protection or an ally dying.

Step Three: The Awakening

After Steps One and Two, spend 5 Down-Time and 2,000 Ryo honing your identity and style to gain Superior Shinobi level 1.

Leveling

At each appropriate character-level requirement, spend 3 Down-Time and 1,200 Ryo to gain the next Class Mod level. These costs are a guide and may be changed by the DM.

You have trained yourself to the point you can be called a Superior Shinobi.

  • Gain 4 Ability Score Increases. These increases can raise a score and its maximum to 22.
  • Your AC increases by 1.
  • Your Speed increases by 30 ft.
  • Gain proficiency in one Saving Throw of your choice.

  • Choose three Skills to become proficient in.
  • Gain 3 Masteries to apply to Skills in which you are proficient.
  • When spending Hit Dice or Chakra Dice during a Rest or through Superior Reserves, you cannot roll below half the die.

You gain Reserve Dice according to your Class Mod level. Up to twice per round, at any time, expend a Reserve Die on either Health or Chakra. Roll a Hit Die or Chakra Die respectively without modifiers. Gain the result as Temporary Hit Points or Temporary Chakra Points; double Temporary Hit Points gained this way. These temporary points last 1 minute.

When you have no Reserve Dice left, you may activate this ability by expending 1 Hit Die or Chakra Die instead. For each Class Mod level beyond 1st, you may use Superior Reserves one additional time per round.

Recover half your Reserve Dice on a Short Rest and all of them on a Long or Full Rest. Use the Superior Shinobi tracker button to roll and apply these resources.

At level 1, learn two Superior Techniques. Learn two additional Techniques at every later Class Mod level.

Each Technique has an Active Cost in Hit Dice or Chakra Dice. Each Technique also gains a number of free uses per Long Rest equal to your Proficiency Bonus minus 2; a free use does not consume dice.

Each Technique can trigger only once per round as a Special Action. You gain this Special Action for every Superior Technique you know, but may use no more than three Superior Techniques in a round. Techniques tied to a Class or Clan require it to be your Main Class or Main Clan.

The module tracks each Technique’s free uses and prompts for payment when its activity is used.

At the end of a combat, count Reserve Dice, Hit Dice, and Chakra Dice spent through this Class Mod. For every two dice spent, gain 1 Burden Point. Burden has a maximum of 30. For every point you would gain beyond 30, take 1d12 Necrotic damage that cannot be reduced or avoided.

Recovery: Short Rest -2 Burden; Long Rest -8; Full Rest -14.

Once per round, before an Attack Roll is made or an enemy rolls a Saving Throw, declare a Perfect Hit. Only one creature may suffer its effects at a time.

  • Attack Roll: Increase Critical Range by 2, to a maximum of 15-20, and gain +1 to hit.
  • Saving Throw: A natural 1, 2, or 3 takes extra damage equal to double the dice, and the DC increases by 1.
  • If a critical/fumble occurs only because of Perfect Hit, only one set of dice is increased by the critical result.
  • If the attack does not critically strike or the target does not fumble, the target still takes extra damage equal to half the relevant set of damage dice.

A Consistent Hit

Instead of increasing Critical/Fumble range, gain +1d8 on the Attack Roll or impose -1d4 on the Saving Throw. A Consistent Hit gains none of the other Perfect Hit benefits.

Gain +2d6 to Clash Checks and the ability to Clash with Class Mod Arts.
Once per turn, spend 10 Chakra as a Free Action to remove up to two ranks of a Mental Condition.
Gain two additional non-Class Mod Adversary Traits above the normal limit.
Create a custom/homebrew Jutsu stronger than a regular Jutsu of its level; the Adversary halves its cost.
Choose two known Jutsu and significantly alter them, such as increased damage, lower cost, or entirely new traits.
Once per turn, reroll one failed Attack Roll or Saving Throw and take the higher result.
Gain advantage on Initiative Checks and cannot be Surprised.
Once per turn, when a creature misses an Attack Roll against the Adversary within melee range, make an Unarmed or Weapon Attack.
Increase Critical Range for all Attack Rolls by 1.
Spend Chakra equal to four times the Jutsu Rank (D=4, S=20) to increase its Attack Roll or DC by 2.
Reduce the cost of all Jutsu by 2 per rank (D=2, S=10).
Prerequisite: Legendary Superiority. Gain the Level 3 benefits of a different Epithet.
